$description: OPAX design tokens: the one source for the web (portal/public/tokens.css and the generated :root region of style.css) and the app (mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts, re-exported by palette.ts and tokens.ts). Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build_tokens.mjs`; tests fail while a generated file is stale. Values are CSS px on the web and points on iOS (dp on Android): one CSS pixel is one point. Names: a colour role's key is its app name; its web name is `--` plus the key in kebab case unless `web.name` says otherwise. References like {inkSoft} name another colour role and resolve in the same theme. Rules for using these: docs/design/DESIGN-REVIEW-2026-10.md section 2. Names, aliases and deprecations: docs/design/TOKENS.md.

opax.rules: Screens use role names, never hex values.
Navy is the single tint. Category inks are reserved for subject symbols and figures; bands carry edition plates.
Party colour is a dot beside a readable party name, never colour alone, never a chart series.
inkFaint is for paper and raised surfaces only; use inkSoft on sunken surfaces and washes.
Bronze is reserved for the mark, app icon, launch artwork and Today's decorative dot map. Links use navy.

themes.$description: Both platforms are light-only (app decision 2; the web sets color-scheme: light). Every colour role still carries a dark value, held to the same contrast rules, so a dark theme is a wiring change rather than a design pass. Increase Contrast (iOS) applies today; the web's prefers-contrast: more block is written only when `web.prefersContrast` is true.

sunken.$description: Subdued surface: pressed rows, the empty portrait circle, skeleton bars.

inkSoft.$description: Secondary text, metadata, fine print. 6.5:1 on paper, 6.0:1 on sunken.

inkFaint.$description: Tertiary text on paper and raised only (4.56 and 4.80:1). Fails on sunken and on washes.

onNavy.$description: Text and icons on a navy (or danger) fill.

link.$description: Semantic link tone, always the single navy tint.

navy.$description: Structure and the one primary action per view.

navyWash.$description: Secondary button fill; the people accent's wash; the selected row in a split list. Stronger under Increase Contrast (1.35:1 on paper, 1.58:1 dark) so a selection still reads beside the stronger rules.

bronze.$description: Brand artwork only: mark, icon and launch screen. Never a link or text tint.

todayDotBronze.$description: Today's decorative dot map highlight, at 76 percent opacity over a navy base at 23 percent. Matches today-header-v2. Never a link or text tint.

bronzeInk.$description: Brand artwork only: mark, icon and launch screen. Never a link or text tint.

bronzeWash.$description: Brand artwork only: mark, icon and launch screen. Never a link or text tint.

bronzeRule.$description: Link underlines on the web: present, not heavy. The app has none (links are rows).

bronzeBright.$description: Brand artwork only: mark, icon and launch screen. Never a link or text tint.

dividerDefault.$description: The top rule of a section; major content boundaries. Decorative (1.97:1).

dividerSubtle.$description: Between rows, under subheadings, card outlines. Decorative (1.30:1).

lineControl.$description: Field and segmented-control boundaries only (3.33:1). Never a content divider.

dangerPressed.$description: A pressed destructive fill (the End call button).

accent.$description: Category inks and washes. An ink is AA text on paper, raised, sunken and its own wash; ink and inkSoft are AA on every wash. Use only for the 2pt section mark, the display figure of a block, an icon tile and a Today tile: never links, rules, chip fills or body text.

moneyWash.$description: The money tile and header wash.

votesWash.$description: The votes tile and header wash.

interestsWash.$description: The interests tile and header wash.

billsInk.$description: Bills: bills, stages, exposure drafts; also the machine-written label.

billsWash.$description: The bills tile and header wash.

bandBills.$description: Edition plate ground. Uses onBand and onBandSoft, never a link tint.

bandMoney.$description: Edition plate ground. Uses onBand and onBandSoft, never a link tint.

bandVotes.$description: Edition plate ground. Uses onBand and onBandSoft, never a link tint.

bandInterests.$description: Edition plate ground. Uses onBand and onBandSoft, never a link tint.

bandPeople.$description: Edition plate ground. Uses onBand and onBandSoft, never a link tint.

onBand.$description: Titles and art on edition bands.

onBandSoft.$description: Kicker and detail on edition bands.

category.$description: A screen's subject and its accent pair (role names). People and places share navy.

status.$description: Status labels: bill stage, division outcome, vote side. Always a word; the tone only reinforces it.

done.$description: Passed, agreed to, became law, voted for.

mark.$description: Neutral fallback. Charts accept their subject ink from the caller.

contrast.$description: The second series where a chart compares two (noes against ayes).

industry.$description: The money map's 16 industry clusters, in legend order: a hue and an ink darkened for 4.5:1 text on paper. Light only. Copied today in portal/graph/palette.ts, app.js, ledger.js, home.html and the app's features/money/ported/palette.ts; those move to these values in a later pass.

party.$description: One set for both platforms: a dot (10pt, always beside the party name, 3:1 on paper and raised) and a 12% wash for a party's own header (ink and inkSoft stay AA on it). `web` is the web's short key (--party-alp, --party-alp-wash). The money-map exporters still draw their own party colours until pass 2D moves them here.

serif.$description: Titles, headings, record text, display figures. The app registers static Merriweather Regular and Bold; Bold stands in for the web's 600.

sans.web: "Public Sans", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

space.$description: One vertical rhythm for both platforms (the app's rhythm, adopted by the web). Section and screen steps grow at regular width (iPad regular, web 701px and over).

line.$description: A line bound to the line above: a date under a title.

tight.$description: Inside a row or group: a name to its party line.

row.$description: Vertical row padding. A 22pt line plus 11pt above and below meets the 44pt minimum.

heading.$description: A section heading to its first block.

group.$description: A second list or group inside a section.

section.$description: Between sections; the rule sits at the top of each.

screen.$description: 20pt default. Adaptive margins use 16 below 414pt, 20 from 414pt, and 32 at regular width.

groupHeader.$description: Group header to its inset group.

radius.$description: Continuous corners. Canonical names express purpose; legacy names are deprecated aliases.

hairline.$description: Every rule, row line and card outline. 1px = 1pt, not the device hairline.

focus.$description: The focus ring (bronzeInk on paper, bronzeBright on navy), a field error, Composer focus.

accentMarkWidth.$description: The short accent stroke over the start of a section's top rule. Only where sections differ in category (profiles, Today).

masthead.$description: The bronze rule under the web masthead and over the footer. The only 3px rule.

elevation.$description: Structure is hairlines. One shadow, for things that float over the page. App: native sheets and menus draw their own.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, the web source sheet, the map popup, the docked chat.

edition.$description: Edition card only. No shadow in dark.

motion.$description: Three durations and one curve. Under Reduce Motion (prefers-reduced-motion) nothing moves: colour changes only, loaders draw a still frame.

standard.$description: Disclosure open, chevron turn, chip select.

gentle.$description: Portrait fade-in, answer reveal, sheet content.

standard.$description: The house curve for every UI transition. Progress bars and ambient loops run linear.

ambientLoop.$description: The period of the one ambient loop (the wombat walk, the Talk orb breath). Not a transition duration.

target.$description: Minimum hit area. Visuals may be smaller inside it.

controlCompact.$description: The web's compact control grows to 44 on coarse pointers.

portraitRow.$description: A blank sunken circle when there is no portrait; never initials.

iconSm.$description: Three icon sizes (the app draws 11 today). Icons scale with text to 2x.

readable.$description: Readable column: 700pt in the app, a 68ch measure on the web.

regular.$description: iPad regular width; the web's first layout step (min-width 701px).

contrast.$description: The pairs the tokens promise, checked in light, dark and both Increase Contrast themes by the web and app token tests. `text` pairs need 4.5:1, `nonText` 3:1, `strong` 7:1 under Increase Contrast only. `forbidden` pairs must fail AA in light: components never draw them. Party dots and washes are checked separately (dot 3:1 on paper and raised; ink and inkSoft AA on every wash). Component-level pairs (every state of every control) stay in the app's contrast.ts.

forbidden.$description: Use inkSoft on sunken surfaces and washes.
Bronze is for rules and chart marks.

deprecated.$description: Old names kept for one release so no screen breaks. An `alias` has the same value as its replacement and points at it; a `value` is the old look, kept until a later pass moves its uses to the replacement (`change` says what moving will change). The generator writes these into tokens.css, style.css and tokens.generated.ts with a deprecation comment, and lists them in docs/design/TOKENS.md.

s6.use: rhythm.section, or rhythm.screen at regular width
